what: Every waiting request carries its own filled teal Approve/Review pill with the teal glow shadow, next to a grey Decline pill. Things to do shows 7 filled pills in one card (plus 3 tinted Fill/Find cover pills); Time off requests shows 7; Time corrections 4. On the phone the pair is two 48px full-width pills per row, so the page is a column of 14 buttons.
why: One primary action per view (better-layout) and 'fill exactly one action per view' (better-colors); CR-203 one reserved accent. When every row shouts, nothing is primary and the squint test shows a stripe of teal blobs instead of a list. The glow on each pill adds visual noise and makes the list feel heavy rather than calm.
fix: In lists, make Approve/Review the tinted pill already used for 'Find cover' (background --b-teal-50 #E8F3F1, text --b-teal 600, no shadow, height 40px desktop / 44px phone, min-width 96px) and Decline a text button (--b-ink2, 600, no fill). Keep the filled teal pill with --b-elev-glow only on the request's own detail page and on the single top item when a card has one. Phone: put the pair on one 44px row aligned to the text edge, not two 48px slabs.

what: Rows repeat the same title. 'Time correction waiting for review' appears 4 times, with the only useful fact (the person) in the grey sub-line followed by filler ('Recorded time correction.'). Notifications is five rows all titled 'Operations need review' with only a relative time under each.
why: Wall of equal-weight rows (TS-010 editing vs listing; CR-101 hierarchy). The bold line carries no information, so the owner must read the grey line of every row. Notifications gives no reason to open any row. This is the clearest 'unfinished' signal in the set.
fix: Corrections: title = person ('James Ortiz'), sub = what changed ('Clock-out fix · Mon, Nov 10 · +20 min'), drop the trailing period. Notifications: title = the specific event ('3 time-off requests are waiting', 'Gabriela Santos missed clock-in'), sub = 'Things to do · 4 min ago'; group consecutive same-type rows into one ('5 reviews waiting').

what: The same quantities are written in different formats, and one disagrees. Home says '447 h Scheduled'; Schedule's grid header says '11 people · 446.5 h' for the same week. Durations appear as '8 h 11' (small h, bare minutes), '182 h 36 min', '1 h 00', '30 min', '60.5 h', '447 h', '182 h 38 min', '8 h 51 min under plan'. Time ranges appear as '12p–12a' (grid), '12–5:30 AM' and '5 AM – 1 PM' (phone list, unspaced then spaced), '1:00 PM–12:00 AM' (Home), '12:00 PM – 8:00 PM' (Things to do). Date ranges: 'Nov 9 – 15', 'Nov 2 – Nov 8', 'Nov 9–15'. Shift requests' expanded detail adds the year ('Tue, Nov 17, 2026') where nothing else does.
why: Consistency and trust (TS-006 single voice; better-typography tabular numbers). In a time-and-pay product, two totals for one week (447 vs 446.5) reads as an error, and five duration formats make columns impossible to scan.
fix: One formatter per kind, used everywhere: duration 'H h MM min' in prose and 'H h MM' in numeric columns (never decimal hours next to it; round Home to match Schedule or show 446.5 h in both); time range '9:00 AM – 5:00 PM' with spaced en dash in rows, compact '9a–5p' only inside the week grid; date range 'Nov 9 – 15' (same month) and 'Nov 30 – Dec 2'; no year unless it differs from the current one. Apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to every figure column.
where: src/components/owner-b/home-b.tsx (This week figures); src/components/manager-weekly-roster.tsx (grid header); src/components/timecards.tsx:529; src/lib/action-center/project.ts

what: A pale grey strip about 10px tall cuts across the teal band between the title 'Time corrections' and its sub-line. The band reads as two separate teal blocks with a seam.
why: A visible rendering seam on a brand surface cheapens the page instantly (CR-402 one strong edge; aesthetic-usability).
fix: Put the phone sub-line inside the hero (BHero sub) or give .c-phone-sub the band background with margin-top: 0 so it joins the band; remove the gap between header and paragraph.

what: Two 'Prepare' buttons above the fold for different pay periods: a small filled teal 'Prepare' in the red notice (oldest period) and a large tinted 'Prepare payroll' under the three steps (current period). The bigger button is the secondary one. The hero also shows two empty stat tiles ('People —', 'Gross —').
why: One primary action per view; size and fill disagree about which action matters. Empty tiles in the hero spend the most valuable space on dashes (TS-005 edge cases).
fix: Name the period on each button ('Prepare Oct 26 – Nov 1' as on desktop; 'Start Nov 9 – 15'), and while a backlog exists collapse the steps card to one row ('Nov 9 – 15 · opens after the backlog'). Hide People and Gross until a payroll exists; show Payday alone as a single wide tile, or replace with 'Timecards 0 of 12 approved'.

what: The 'Covered this week' block is one small grey tile ('Staffing 59% · 198 h of 336 h', 200px wide on Schedule, 100px on Home) sitting alone at the left of a 1080px card, followed by a loose line 'Positions and leads aren't required'. On Schedule this occupies 150px of height above the grid with about 850px of empty white beside it.
why: Large dead area and an orphaned element at the top of the product's main working screen (CR-501 density, CR-004 rhythm). It looks like two tiles failed to load.
fix: Make coverage a single inline row in the card header: 'Staffing 59%' (amber 700, 15px) + a 160px progress bar (6px, amber to 59%) + '198 h of 336 h' (grey 13.5px), on the same line as the legend. Remove the tile surface and drop the 'aren't required' line (or move it to an info tooltip). This returns ~110px to the grid.

what: Row titles in the Things to do card start on two different edges: rows led by an icon circle start at x=81 ('Cover 2 open shifts', 'Fill Ana Colon's shift'); the row led by an avatar starts at x=77 ('1 missed clock-in'). The avatar is 32px and the icon circle 36px.
why: CR-402 one strong edge. A 4px drift in the first card of the first screen is exactly the kind of misalignment that reads as unpolished.
fix: One lead slot: 36px wide for both avatar and icon circle (avatar 36px, 12.5/700 initials), 12px gap, so every title starts at the same x. On desktop it is already uniform (x=377); match that rule on phones.

what: Desktop: a light grey strip 'Offline · updated 4:46 AM' is inserted between the teal top bar and the teal hero, splitting the band in two. Phone: the same message is a dark toast floating over the 'Staffing 59%' tile, covering content. In both, 'Prepare payroll' still looks fully enabled, the 'Clocked in' dot stays green over a dash, and Things to do is a one-line stub.
why: Error states should feel designed (TS-005). The strip breaks the brand band; the toast hides data; live-looking controls offline mislead (better-colors: state shown truthfully).
fix: Show offline as a glass pill inside the hero under the title on both widths (amber dot + 'Offline · showing 4:46 AM', 13.5/600, --b-glass background), remove the strip and the toast. Grey the status dots, and give 'Prepare payroll' the disabled pair (--b-disabled-bg / --b-disabled-ink). Things to do: state card with icon circle, 'Can't check right now', 'Your list returns when you're back online.'

what: Two content widths coexist: Home, Schedule, Timecards, Insights and Settings end at x=1376; every other page ends at x=1108, leaving a 270px empty column on the right. Band actions follow the narrow edge (Edit, Save, New update at x=1108) so they float mid-band, not under the top bar's right edge (x=1400).

For list pages (Updates, Notifications, Requests, Payroll) use the Things-to-do layout: 812px list plus a 300px right rail (filters, summary or shortcuts) so the full 1080px grid is used.

what: Band height and title position change on almost every page: band bottoms at 154, 160, 186, 196, 198, 216, 219, 221, 264, 289, 296px; title baselines at about 107, 110, 148, 152 and 190px. The first card sits 24px below the band on some pages (Notifications, Requests) and overlaps it on others (Home, Schedule, Timecards, Things to do; Updates overlaps by only 12px).
why: Spacing rhythm and consistency (CR-004, TS-006). The header jumping by a few pixels between pages is felt as jitter even when not consciously noticed.
fix: Three band presets only: compact 160px (title only), standard 200px (title + sub or back link) and with-controls 296px (tabs or stat strip). Title top fixed at 96px, back link at 64px above it inside the same box. One rule for the first card: overlap the band by 56px on root tabs, sit 24px below it on pushed pages.

what: The relative time ('1 min ago', '7 min ago') sits in the row's right side at body size and squeezes the sub-line, which wraps badly: 'Thu, Nov 12 · 1:00 PM –' / '5:00 PM', and 'Mon, Nov 30 – Wed, Dec 2' / '· 3 days' (a line starting with a separator dot). Callout rows wrap to four lines.
why: Orphans and broken ranges (better-typography: wrap deliberately). The least important fact (how long ago) takes space from the most important (when).
fix: Move the age into the sub-line's end or drop it on phones ('Thu, Nov 12 · 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM' on one line; age as 12.5px grey under the name only when over 24 h). Wrap each range in white-space: nowrap and break only at ' · '. Callout sub: 'Can't work Tue, Nov 17 · 8:00 AM' only; reason shows on expand.

what: In the Time off card the chevron sits in the middle of the row, before the buttons, and its x position changes between rows (about x=780 for 'Review' rows, x=770 for 'Approve' rows) because the two buttons have different widths. Rows with an amber overlap warning are 87px tall, the others 55px.
why: Trailing elements should share an edge (CR-402); a chevron between text and buttons has no clear meaning.
fix: Give the primary pill a fixed width (96px) so both labels fit, and remove the chevron on rows that have buttons (the row itself links to detail), or place it last at the card's right inset. Keep the overlap warning on one line with ellipsis at this width.

what: Each request is a two-storey row: name and date on top, then Decline/Approve alone on a second line at the far right, 112px per request with a wide empty band between. The same requests on Things to do are single 55px rows with inline buttons.
why: Over-airy region and inconsistency between two views of the same object (CR-501).
fix: At 768px and up use the Things-to-do row: avatar, name + sub, age (grey 13px), then the button pair inline; row height 64px. Only the overlap warning adds a second line.
where: request list styles in src/app/app/owner-b-desktop.css; src/components/owner-b/inbox-b.tsx (reuse row)

what: One state has four names: chip 'Pending' (Time corrections), chip 'Waiting' (time-off detail, tabs), 'Correction awaiting review' (Timecards), '· waiting' appended to card titles ('Time corrections · waiting', 'Timecards to approve · waiting'). Also 'Time off' vs 'Time-off request', and 'Can't work' vs 'callout' vs 'Shift requests'.
why: One voice, one vocabulary (better-writing). Different words suggest different states.
fix: Use 'Waiting' everywhere for 'needs the owner's decision' (chip amber). Timecards chip: 'Correction waiting'. Drop the '· waiting' suffix; title the cards 'Time corrections' and 'Timecards to approve' and move not-due-today ones under a grey group label 'Not due today'. Pick 'Time off' without hyphen as the noun and 'Time-off request' only as a compound modifier.

what: The same two-sentence note ('Times in Puerto Rico time. Approving changes the timecard; the original clock times stay in the history.') is printed inside all four cards. On desktop the section title 'Correction requests 4' sits on the canvas, unlike other pages where the title is inside the card.
why: Repetition adds length without information (TS-010); the phone page is about 2,250px for four items.
fix: Say it once under the page title (it already half-exists as the band sub-line: 'Fixes your team asked for. Original times are always kept. Times in Puerto Rico time.') and remove it from the cards. Pass the note only to the first card or to the list header.

what: The table spans 1080px but its four columns end at about x=910; the right 460px of every row is empty and rows have no chevron or hover affordance, so nothing says they open. Nine of eleven status chips are the same grey 'In progress'. Tab counts ('All 12', 'In progress 11') are set at about 12px.
why: Dead area and a column of identical chips (CR-501; wall of equal weight). The exceptions (2 corrections, 1 missing clock-out) do not stand out.
fix: Show a status chip only for exceptions; 'In progress' becomes plain grey text. Add right-aligned columns the owner needs ('Scheduled', 'Difference') or right-align Status with a trailing chevron at the card inset. Sort exceptions first. Tab labels 14/600 with the 20px count pill from --b-seg tokens.

what: Every row has an unlabelled teal progress bar under it with no scale (what is 100%?). Rows are three different heights (75, 93, 99px) because chips and wrapped sub-lines ('Clocked in now ·' then '30 min breaks' on the next line, ending a line with a separator) push content. The '8 h 11' value column is ragged against the bar ends.
why: Unexplained graphics are decoration (meaningful not decorative); inconsistent row heights break rhythm (CR-004).
fix: Either label the bar ('of 40 h scheduled') or remove it on phones. Fix row height at 72px: line 1 name + chip, line 2 one sub-line with nowrap segments. Right-align the hours with tabular-nums at a fixed 72px column.

what: Desktop and phone are different designs. Phone: hero with 'Up next · Nov 9–15', stat strip, a red icon tile on the notice, the steps card, amounts labelled 'Net · Approved'. Desktop: plain band with tabs, the notice title in red text with no icon, a bare 'Up next' row, no steps, amounts with no label. On the phone the 'Replaced' payroll is not nested under its correction (DESIGN.MD says it nests at every width) and its $6,060.75 has the same weight as live amounts.
why: The page that should feel most trustworthy is the plainest on desktop and the two widths teach different models (TS-006).
fix: Desktop: bring over the phone's 'Up next' block as a right-rail ink card (period, payday, 'Prepare' steps), add the 36px red-50 icon circle to the notice and set its title in ink 600 (red only on the icon), label amounts 'Net'. Both widths: nest the replaced row (24px indent, connector line) and set its amount in --b-grey with line-through.

what: 'Notifications didn't load' is followed by the body 'Try again.' and then a grey button 'Try again': the same words twice, no icon circle. On desktop the 404 card has no icon and no title ('This page doesn't exist' is missing), only a 12.5px grey line and a button, while the phone 404 has the full state card.
why: DESIGN.MD's state card (icon circle, 16/22 title, line, pill) is not applied; duplicate copy looks auto-generated (better-writing: say what happened and what to do).
fix: Use BState everywhere: 36px red-50 circle with warning glyph, title 'Notifications didn't load' (16/22 600), line 'Check your connection, then try again.', one tinted pill 'Try again'. Restore the icon and title on the desktop 404.

what: The page shows 'Loading update…' as the big band title with a sub-line, above a completely empty canvas. No placeholder cards. (This capture caught the loading state; the 1440 capture shows the loaded page.)
why: Loading should hold the layout (DESIGN.MD F5 BLoadingScreen). A status sentence as an H1 over a blank page reads as broken.
fix: Keep the band title as 'Update' (or the known title from the list) and render the kit's placeholder: two 22px cards of #ECEEEF bars. Move 'Getting the latest version…' to an sr-only status.

what: The Edit pill floats at y=159, above and right of the title (title at y=190), not on its baseline. The message card has 28px above the text and 46px below. 'Withdraw update' is bare red text on the canvas under the cards.
why: Optical alignment and uneven padding (CR-401, CR-001); a destructive action as loose text looks unfinished.
fix: Centre Edit on the title's line box and anchor it to the band's right edge. Card padding 24px top and bottom. Put Withdraw in a card row (red-50 circle with icon, 'Withdraw update', red 600) like 'Delete shift' on the phone form.

screens: Add employee, Add shift, New location, New update, Company profile (1440)
what: Inputs stretch the full 766px of the card: a First name field 376px wide, Mobile phone and Note 766px wide. The label and field inset is 319px on some forms and 318px on others (New location, Company profile, New update). On New update, Cancel/Next live in the band; on the other forms they are in a card footer.
why: Over-wide fields misstate the expected input length and leave the form feeling stretched (better-layout: size to content); two action placements for one pattern.
fix: Form column max-width 560px inside the card (fields: names 2 x 272px, phone 272px, email 560px). One inset (24px from the card edge everywhere). One action placement on desktop: card footer, Cancel (quiet) + primary, right-aligned; band has no buttons on forms.

what: Two error styles: Add employee shows a red circle-exclamation icon plus 'Enter first name' (no article, no period); New location shows no icon and 'Enter a location name.' (article and period). The partial phone error reads 'A ten-digit phone number', which is not an instruction.
why: One pattern per state (TS-006); colour alone should not carry the error (better-accessibility), so the icon version is the right one.
fix: Everywhere: 16px bold warning glyph + message in --b-red 13.5/18, sentence without period: 'Enter a first name', 'Enter a location name', 'Enter all 10 digits of the phone number'.

what: The note 'Locked while you have shifts' sits 2–3px above the divider line (text bottom about y=471, line at y=474), touching it, with 30px of empty space above it. Save is a filled teal pill inside the card on desktop and a white pill in the band on phone.
why: Text too close to an edge (CR-001/CR-003).
fix: Move the reason under each locked value as the DESIGN.MD read-only pattern says (grey value, 16px lock, reason beneath), or give the note 12px above and 16px below. Save appears only after a change (as Availability does).

what: Locked toggles: the explanation ('7 requests for time off are waiting for a decision. Decide them first.') sits 30px below its label with a gap, making those rows 98px against 60px for the others, and it reads as a separate item. The lock is a tiny 12px outline glyph after the label, and the switch still looks fully on and tappable. Faint inner rounded corners are visible at the top of each list inside the card (a card-in-card seam at y=268 and y=640).
why: Proximity (CR-002): the reason must sit with the thing it explains. A locked control that looks live invites a dead tap.
fix: Put the reason directly under the label as the row's sub-line (13.5/18 grey, 2px gap), row min-height 64px. Lock glyph 16px bold per DESIGN.MD. Draw the locked switch at 60% opacity with the lock inside the thumb. Remove the inner list's own radius/background.

what: 'Hours by day' on desktop: 32px bars in 148px slots, so the chart is mostly white; Wednesday's '1' is a hairline; Thu–Sun are empty labels. No planned-hours reference though the card above talks about plan. Attendance shows two dashes ('Late clock-ins —', 'Cover filled —') with a paragraph explaining why.
why: The analytics page should be the most satisfying; this one looks sparse and partly empty (CR-501; TS-005).
fix: Bars 56px wide with 6px top radius, max-width per slot 72px, 120px chart height; draw each day's planned hours as a light teal-50 backing bar so future days show plan instead of nothing; minimum bar height 4px. Attendance: hide tiles with no data and show one line 'Late clock-ins appear once this week's clock-ins are checked.'
where: insights/reports page component under src/app/app/reports; src/app/app/owner-b-desktop.css

what: The Open shifts row holds 22 amber dashed chips stacked four deep (Wed–Sun), 145px tall, while Mon and Tue show plain text '4 open'. It is the heaviest thing on the page and pushes the team down. The 'Show 1 unscheduled' link at the foot is 12.5px and inset differently (x=318) from the rows (x=319/363).
why: Amber means 'check'; 22 amber outlines make the whole week look alarming (CR-203) and two representations of the same thing in one row is inconsistent.
fix: Collapse each day to one chip: '4 open' (amber-50 fill, amber 600 text, 28px) that expands on click to the list, for all seven days; row height 56px. Footer link 14/600 at the row inset.

what: The business switcher truncates the name on every page: 'Northside Café & B…'. The Things to do count in the sidebar is a red pill ('16'), while the phone bell uses a teal count and the desktop bell a coral dot.
why: A truncated company name in the brand corner is a daily paper cut (better-typography: truncate with a way back). Red means stop in this system; a to-do count is not an error, and three badge styles compete.
fix: Let the name wrap to two lines (13.5/17 600, card height 56px) or widen the sidebar from 232 to 248px; add title/tooltip. Badge: one count style everywhere: 20px pill, 12/700, teal fill with white text for counts; reserve red for failures.

what: The collapsed sub-line already jams everything in ('Can't work Tue, 8:00 AM · Transportation issue · Car is in the shop until Wednesday'), then the expanded panel repeats it as stacked lines at 16px grey, larger than the 13.5px sub-line above. Each shift is four separate lines (title, date with year, time, place).
why: Hierarchy inverted (detail larger than summary, CR-101) and duplicated content.
fix: Collapsed: 'Can't work · Tue, Nov 17 · 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM'. Expanded: a two-column definition list at 14.5/20 (label grey 13px: Shift, Reason, Note), each shift on one line 'Tue, Nov 17 · 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM · Condado', inside a --b-quiet rounded 14px block like the Recorded/Asked-for blocks on Time corrections.

The three hero stat tiles are 360px wide each for a one- or two-digit number. At 1024 '11 timecards to review' wraps to two lines against 'Before payroll'.

what: Chips come in several sizes and surfaces: 'Published' white pill; 'Payday in 9 days' white pill with amber text; 'In 9 days' amber-on-ink; table chips about 11.5px in 20px pills; card chips 12.5px in 22–24px pills; 'Not assigned' about 11px. what: The phone value '555-0100' is letter-spaced and looks like a different font from 'Not added' and 'Puerto Rico' beside it; it also lacks the area-code format the Add employee placeholder teaches ('(787) 555-0123'). Desktop band has no avatar while the phone band does.

what: After approving, the confirmation is one small green line ('Elena Ruiz's timecard is approved.') and a new filled 'Finalize period' button appears straight under it. The capture is mid-transition (panel translucent over the top bar), so I can't judge the final frame or the motion.

what: The 'Published shifts' card's inner content starts at x=313 while the card above starts at x=319; the action bar's right edge is x=1106 against the cards' 1108. The actions sit on the canvas under the last card.
why: Small edge drift (CR-402).
fix: Use the same 23px inset in both cards; align the action group to the card edge, or place it in a card footer with a top divider.

what: The sheet ends about 60px below 'Approve timecard' and the dimmed list shows beneath; a 'Skip to content' pill is visible over the list (likely a focus artefact of the capture).
why: A sheet that stops mid-screen with content showing through feels less native.
fix: Sheet min-height 100dvh minus 48px on phones, with the primary button sticky at the bottom above the safe area (16px inset).
